title: Like touring Barcelona with a local friend
text: This tour is a must! It felt like exploring Barcelona with a friend who lives there. It was a beautiful walk through areas of the old town that we likely would never have stumbled across on our own. We tried the best versions of local foods and heard about the history behind them.  We would highly recommend to any of our friends traveling to Barcelona.
author: N1120OCshawns

title: Like a Local: Food, Culture, and Wine in One Unforgettable Tour
text: If you’re visiting Barcelona, this walking tour is an absolute must. It was the perfect balance of history, culture, and food—all thoughtfully guided by Jo, who was warm, knowledgeable, and made us feel right at home. We explored hidden corners of the city, sampled authentic Catalan dishes, and gained a deeper understanding of local traditions. The wine tasting at the end was the perfect way to wrap up the experience. Highly recommended!
author: O6344PNdaniellef

title: Knowledgeable local guide...
text: Knowledgeable local guide who picked the perfect places to give a wide variety of local tastes and flavors.  Was lucky enough to be the only two people on the tour.  Could NOT have asked for anything better!
author: Mark_M

title: High Recommended
text: A really enjoyable evening. Joe was an amazing guide. We really had so much fun and great food. Visited places we probably wouldn’t have found ourselves.
author: Gillian_M

title: Don’t Miss this Outstanding Experience!
text: This food and wine experience was truly exceptional. Not only were the bespoke and truly local gems the best in Barcelona, but the rich history and expert insights from our guide Anie made it a night will not soon forget. If you have an opportunity when visiting this wonderful City, this is one tour you don’t want to miss. I can’t recommend enough!
author: Kelley D

title: A non-tour kinda tour!! Felt like having a great time with your local friend!! Who happens to know everything!!
text: An absolute must!! Our guide and now friend, Sevan, was magical!! The food, drinks, history and wine was so great!! And Sevan knew so much about all of it!! 10 out of 10 experience!! Thank you Sevan!! Cheers!! 👀🥳
author: D9926RVamyt

title: very local and fun walk around Old Town Barcelona
text: We had a wonderful time exploring and eating tapas with Anie from Vidavivida. And we learned quite a few about history, culture and lifestyle of Barcelona. It was definitely worth the journey!
author: SandroM883

title: If you do anything in Barcelona should be this!
text: I can’t begin to say how much we loved this tour with Anna! We haven’t stopped talking about it and just recommended this to 2 friends since. First off Anna is so fun and knowable about all the things in the city that you’d want to know. Taking us to the most amazing places that are so unforgettable. So much history at 4 cats and the other stops are filled with the delicacies of Spanish food and wines/cocktails. We got to taste and learn all about Spain’s wines at the last stop. author: troleydoly

title: Wonderful experience
text: Wonderful evening. Highly recommend. Maria, our guide, was charming, energetic, knowledgeable, & passionate about Barcelona & Spanish history & culture. We went to 3 restaurants and ate and drank traditional Barcelona food & drink. We tried things we would never had tried on our own. We closed the evening at a wonderful wine bar with fabulous local cavas, whites, & reds. It was a great way to start our trip.
author: 672budp

title: Could not recommend it more!
text: Our favorite thing we did in Barcelona! I have done this tour twice now. So much history along with yummy food and drinks!
